integrity: Exact symbolic proof and separate direct finite predicate checks; finite checks do not establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: The graph has exactly three parts, each at least two, and integer p at least three.
Enumeration of all minimum functions is stated only for the balanced family with p=2a-2.
Absolute priority and independent verification are not established.
title: Exact \(p\)-strong Roman domination of complete tripartite graphs with three defender regimes
